newsitem.title: HONG KONG: GZI Trans mulls China road investment.
newsitem.headline: GZI Trans mulls China road investment.

text.p: GZI Transport Ltd is in preliminary talks to directly participate in a highway construction project in China's Guangzhou, a company official said on Monday.

"We have signed a letter of intent to directly participate in a highway construction project linking Guangzhou to Huadu," Guo Peinan, chairman of GZI Transport, told a press briefing on Monday. "It is still in a preliminary stage."
"The highway, which is about 20-kilometres long, is expected to involve a total investment of HK$400-HK$600 million of which we (GZI Transport) will take a 55 percent stake," Guo said.
Guo declined to comment on when the formal agreement would be signed.
GZI Transport is a spinoff of the Guangzhou municipal government's investment arm, Guangzhou Investment Co Ltd.
The company was listed on January 30, 1997.
